think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type, unit, and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any numeric value is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/enable, auto, infinite), such as 0, -1, or a named sentinel. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
